label: Product Praise
text: I absolutely love this product! It exceeded all my expectations and customer support was wonderful. 😍❤️🔥
notes: Strong positive lexical cues and positive emojis.

label: Service Outrage
text: This service is horrible, completely unacceptable, and customer care was rude and useless! 😡🤬
notes: Intense negative cues and angry emojis.

label: Factual / Schedule
text: The quarterly project review meeting is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM in Conference Room 3B.
notes: Objective information without emotional or polarity tokens.

label: Disappointment & Grief
text: I feel so heartbroken and deeply sad today after hearing the terrible news... 😢💔
notes: Sadness lexicon and broken heart emoji.

label: Sarcastic Delay Complaint
text: Great, another two hour flight delay... absolutely wonderful airline service. 🙃
notes: Demonstrates sarcasm challenge where positive words are used in negative context.

label: Contrastive Review
text: The camera hardware and display are fantastic, but the battery life and heating issues are terrible.
notes: Contains contrastive conjunction 'but' connecting positive and negative aspects.

notes: Tests emoji-only input processing and Unicode extraction.
